items.html: And do not wonder if in several places in the Zohar you will find that the Tree of Knowledge is in Yetzirah — its good is Metatron, and its evil is Samael — for the Tree of Knowledge is only in Assiyah, which has Klipot mingled in holiness. But after Yetzirah descended and clothed in Assiyah, Yetzirah too is called the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil, by the name of Assiyah. And behold, the picture of the Tree of Knowledge, what it was, is well explained.
